 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Rayo Vallecano and Elche CF clash this Saturday at the Estadio de Vallecas for round ten of the La Liga .
 Rayo Vallecano have picked up 9 points and currently lie in 14th position. Last time out, Beñat San José 's team drew 1-1 against Getafe CF (La Liga 2026/27). 
 OneFootball Videos
 Elche CF have won 7 points to date and are placed in 18th position. In their last outing, Martín Anselmi 's team drew 0-0 against Villarreal CF (La Liga 2026/27).
 The last meeting between the two teams ended with Rayo Vallecano winning 1-0 .
